name: What construction features indicate high-quality kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What construction features indicate high-quality kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quality cabinets feature solid wood face frames, plywood box construction (rather than thin particleboard), and dovetailed drawer boxes. Look for heavy-duty soft-close drawer glides and multi-way adjustable hinges that keep doors hanging straight. In Colorado's dry climate, durable finishes and well-constructed materials prevent premature cracking or panel shrinkage. Selecting cabinets with sturdy backs and thick shelving ensures your storage will handle heavy dishware without sagging over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for plywood box construction, solid wood face frames, dovetailed drawers, full-extension soft-close glides, and heavy-duty adjustable hinges.
